title: What It Really Takes to Succeed After Growing Up in Care

sentences.en: Sometimes we get so used to doing things a certain way that we forget there might be other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有时我们太习惯于用某种方式做事，以至于忘记了可能还有其他选择。

sentences.en: That can most definitely apply to our working lives too.
sentences.zh: 这一点绝对也适用于我们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and one of the biggest changes I've made in my career has been exploring ways to earn money beyond traditional one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我职业生涯中做出的最大改变之一，就是探索传统一对一工作之外的赚钱方式。

sentences.zh: 我很乐意你加入我们。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
sentences.zh: 现在继续我们的节目。

sentences.en: Jacob entered the care system age five, moved between foster homes, endured a failed adoption and still became one of the youngest trainee psychologists in the country.
sentences.zh: Jacob 五岁时进入照护系统，辗转于不同的寄养家庭，经历过收养失败，但最终还是成为了全国最年轻的心理学实习生之一。

sentences.en: But the real story isn't that he made it, it's what he had to unlearn, survive and rebuild along the way.
sentences.zh: 但真正的故事不在于他成功了，而在于他一路走来必须克服、幸存并重建了什么。

sentences.en: If you've ever wondered what resilience and compassion really look like, this conversation will stay with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经好奇过韧性和同理心到底是什么样子的，这段对话会让你久久难忘。

sentences.en: If you find it helpful, like and subscribe for more.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有帮助，请点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Jacob Maspero-Battayo.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾 Jacob Maspero-Battayo。

sentences.en: Hi Jacob.
sentences.zh: 你好，Jacob。

sentences.en: Hi Marianne, thanks for having me on the podcaSt. I'm really excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 你好，Marianne，感谢邀请我参加播客。我很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm excited to host you.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴能接待你。

sentences.en: And you and I have been in each other's DMs for almost three years now, because I checked earlier.
sentences.zh: 我刚才查了一下，你我已经在私信里聊了快三年了。

sentences.en: And it's been really lovely sort of following a little bit of your story.
sentences.zh: 能一路关注你的故事，感觉真的很棒。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about you, if that's okay, Jacob?
sentences.zh: Jacob，如果不介意的话，能跟我们简单介绍一下你自己吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So three years, that sounds like a really long time.
sentences.zh: 三年，听起来是很长的一段时间。

sentences.en: But I suppose my story did start about three years ago when I kind of finished my undergraduate degree in psychology.
sentences.zh: 但我想我的故事确实是从大约三年前开始的，当时我刚完成了心理学本科的学习。

sentences.en: And I then started the search for assistant psychologist posts.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始寻找助理心理学家的职位。

sentences.en: And clinical psychology is always something that
sentences.zh: 临床心理学一直是我

sentences.en: I've been interested in.
sentences.zh: 感兴趣的领域。

sentences.en: And I suppose it was from there that I then started looking.
sentences.zh: 我想就是从那时起我开始寻找机会的。

sentences.en: But underpinning all of this is the fact that I have care experience and I grew up care experienced.
sentences.zh: 但这一切的基础在于我拥有照护经历，我是在照护环境中长大的。

sentences.en: And I think that's been a really important part of my journey that has kind of given me a different lens on what it means
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我人生旅程中非常重要的一部分，它让我以不同的视角看待

sentences.en: to be a clinical psychologist and kind of what makes a good clinical psychologiSt. So it's definitely given me a different spin on the career.
sentences.zh: 什么是临床心理学家，以及什么样的人才是一名优秀的临床心理学家。所以这确实让我的职业生涯有了不同的转折。

sentences.en: Absolutely it has.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Could you define the term care experience for anyone you might not be sure, Jacob?
sentences.zh: Jacob，你能为那些不太确定的人定义一下“照护经历”这个词吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a really interesting and important definition.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是一个非常有趣且重要的定义。

sentences.en: I think older definitions used to kind of speak about care experience in so much as having I think it was 20 days of experience being cared for by a corporate parenting system.
sentences.zh: 我认为旧的定义通常将照护经历描述为，如果我没记错的话，是在企业化育儿系统下接受照护满 20 天的经历。

sentences.en: And a corporate parenting system is a kind of a system of professionals that aim to keep you safe and to keep you kind of cared for, essentially.
sentences.zh: 而企业化育儿系统是一种旨在确保你安全并让你得到基本照护的专业人员系统。

sentences.en: Whereas nowadays, care care experience is something that we most kind of more progressive and compassionate services will view
sentences.zh: 然而在今天，照护经历是大多数更进步、更具同理心的服务机构所认为的

sentences.en: as any length of time that you have been kind of in experience of a corporate parenting system.
sentences.zh: 任何你在企业化育儿系统下接受照护的时间长度。

sentences.en: But also, really importantly, if you have been estranged from your family, if you're not in contact with your family for any reason,
sentences.zh: 但同样非常重要的是，如果你与家人疏远，因为任何原因与家人断绝联系，

sentences.en: and you've had to kind of go at life alone for a certain period of time, that also counts as kind of having that care experience.
sentences.zh: 并且在一段时间内不得不独自面对生活，这也算作拥有那种照护经历。

sentences.en: And I think that's a really important kind of distinction to make.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常重要的区别。

sentences.en: So thank you for bringing that up.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你提出这一点。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for sharing your experiences so kind of honesty and openly.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你如此诚实、坦率地分享你的经历。

sentences.en: And if we're really getting nuts and bolts about this, why is it harder for someone who's care experienced to, to have a professional career specifically in psychology?
sentences.zh: 如果我们深入探讨细节，为什么对于有照护经历的人来说，从事心理学专业工作会更困难？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And it is, it can be harder.
sentences.zh: 确实，这可能会更难。

sentences.en: And it, you know, I can share some of my experience, which might be helpful.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以分享一些我的经历，也许会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So for me, I think, you know, there's this real
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我认为，你知道，有一种真实的

sentences.en: essence of when you're applying or when you're looking to apply to become a trainee clinical psychologist, which, you know, I've managed to do.
sentences.zh: 本质，当你申请或打算申请成为临床心理学实习生时，也就是我成功做到的那样，

sentences.en: There is this sense of, you know, how far back in your history does this application look at?
sentences.zh: 会有这样一种感觉，就是你的申请会追溯到你历史的多久以前？

sentences.en: Some will look at A levels, some, I think, used to even look at GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 有些会看 A-level 成绩，我想以前甚至还有看 GCSE 成绩的。

sentences.en: And I think, for me, I remember when I was doing my GCSEs, I was not a perfect student.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我记得我在考 GCSE 时，并不是一个完美学生。

sentences.en: I didn't really care about doing my GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 我根本不在乎 GCSE 考得怎么样。

sentences.en: I think that's quite a shared experience with so many different people as well.
sentences.zh: 我想这与许多人有着共同的经历。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think, for me, that's where things kind of started.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为对我来说，事情就是从那里开始的。

sentences.en: That's when I was having quite a difficult time of my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我生活中相当困难的一段时期。

sentences.en: And then A levels as well.
sentences.zh: 然后是 A-level 阶段。

sentences.en: That's when I did psychology off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 那时我随性地选了心理学。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to do psychology.
sentences.zh: 我本没打算学心理学。

sentences.en: I was doing fine art, French and photography and decided I don't really like the photography teacher.
sentences.zh: 我当时在学纯艺术、法语和摄影，但我决定我不太喜欢那个摄影老师。

sentences.en: So my friend was opposite to me and said, well, psychology is in that kind of part of the timetable.
sentences.zh: 我朋友坐在我对面说，心理学就在那个时间表里。

sentences.en: Do you want to just switch over?
sentences.zh: 你要不要换过去？

sentences.en: And so I think it was one of the last days I did switch over to psychology and I really enjoyed it, which is really lucky.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在最后几天我换到了心理学，而且我真的很喜欢它，这真的很幸运。

sentences.en: But I suppose from from then on is when I kind of had this newfound interest for what can I do with this knowledge?
sentences.zh: 但我想从那时起，我就对“我能用这些知识做什么”产生了新的兴趣。

sentences.en: This feels important to use.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些知识很有用。

sentences.en: I think we'd learned about kind of Bowlby's monotropic theory of attachment and the still face and all of those things felt really important.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时学了鲍尔比的依恋单向理论、静止脸实验等等，所有这些都感觉非常重要。

sentences.en: And how do I translate them into practice?
sentences.zh: 我该如何将它们转化为实践呢？

sentences.en: So that's when I looked into, you know, what can I do with this?
sentences.zh: 所以我开始研究，我能用这些做什么？

sentences.en: And clinical psychology was, of course, you know, has always been for quite a long time the way that you can apply this knowledge into practice.
sentences.zh: 当然，临床心理学一直以来都是将这些知识应用于实践的途径。

sentences.en: And what makes it difficult is, you know, I've spoken about how far does this application look back in your life,
sentences.zh: 困难之处在于，正如我刚才说的，申请会追溯到你生活的多久以前，

sentences.en: but also the kind of emotional aspects that might come with this experience.
sentences.zh: 还有伴随这种经历而来的情感层面。

sentences.en: So when I got to the point of kind of writing the application,
sentences.zh: 所以当我写申请书的时候，

sentences.en: what also made it difficult was how much do I disclose of myself and is this going to be kind of looked at with a compassionate lens?
sentences.zh: 让我感到困难的还有：我该披露多少关于自己的信息？这会被以一种同理心的眼光看待吗？

sentences.en: Are people going to see the value in this experience or are people going to find this difficult to hold?
sentences.zh: 人们会看到这段经历的价值，还是会觉得难以接受？

sentences.en: So there is this real kind of tension between how much of yourself do you want to bring?
sentences.zh: 所以，你想展现多少真实的自己，这之间存在着真正的张力。

sentences.en: And I think I've always been the person that will kind of champion.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直是一个愿意挺身而出的人。

sentences.en: I'm happy to take on that responsibility of championing care experienced people, not that it is kind of any one person's responsibility,
sentences.zh: 我很乐意承担起支持照护经历者的责任，并不是说这是某一个人的责任，

sentences.en: but it's something that I've always felt particularly passionate about.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我一直特别热衷的事情。

sentences.en: So there is that emotional aspect.
sentences.zh: 所以存在着情感层面。

sentences.en: And then when you're on training, you know, I know we were speaking about earlier, Marianne,
sentences.zh: 然后当你开始实习时，你知道，Marianne，我们之前谈到过，

sentences.en: that the difficulties that can come up with therapeutic relationships and how they can replicate some of those difficult dynamics.
sentences.zh: 治疗关系中可能会出现困难，它们可能会重现一些困难的互动模式。

sentences.en: So there is a real kind of felt sense of, is this going to be difficult for me?
sentences.zh: 所以有一种真实的感受是：这对我来说会很困难吗？

sentences.en: And I suppose, along with that, the systemic barriers, the ones that are kind of harder to change and kind of always there.
sentences.zh: 我想，除此之外，还有系统性的障碍，那些更难改变且一直存在的障碍。

sentences.en: And I suppose, you know, luckily, clinical psychology is a training program that you're paid to do, which is, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，幸运的是，临床心理学是一个带薪的培训项目，这就是为什么

sentences.en: why I think for more and more care experienced and estranged people, that that's kind of the pathway that they want to go down when they think about applying for, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为越来越多的有照护经历和疏远家庭的人，在考虑如何应用他们的心理学知识时，会选择这条道路。

sentences.en: a way that they can apply their psychological knowledge.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，有一段你需要积累经验的时间。

sentences.en: But before that, there's this kind of period of time where you need to build some experience.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，你可能需要担任通常是 Band 4 级别的助理心理学家职位。

sentences.en: And to do that, you might have to take on kind of an assistant psychologist post that is often a band four.
sentences.zh: 我知道也有一些 Band 5 的职位。

sentences.en: I know there are some band fives.
sentences.zh: 如果你能拿到 Band 5，那非常幸运。

sentences.en: And if you are a band five, that's very lucky.
sentences.zh: 我想我们很多人都是 Band 4，或者不再是了。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us are band four or not anymore.
sentences.zh: 但确实，这个薪水很难维持生活。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's it's a difficult salary to live with.
sentences.zh: 而且对很多人来说，心理学并不是他们的第一职业。

sentences.en: And for a lot of people as well, the care experience, psychology isn't their first career.
sentences.zh: 他们已经建立了自己的事业。

sentences.en: They kind of established themselves.
sentences.zh: 我知道我有一些朋友以前是老师，他们拥有非常成熟的职业身份，但赚的钱不足以养家糊口。

sentences.en: I know I've got some friends that were teachers that have had these really well established professional identities that they aren't good enough money to have a family on.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须从头开始。

sentences.en: And then you kind of have to go back from there.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的会很困难。

sentences.en: So that can be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 我认为我特别不满的一点是，这是一个很难谈论的话题，那就是当你申请时，

sentences.en: And I think one of my particular gripes, I would say, in and it's a difficult, difficult thing to talk about is the kind of the fact that when you apply as well,
sentences.zh: 你必须拥有英国心理学会（BPS）认证的心理学学位。

sentences.en: you have to have a BPS accredited psychology degree.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我只能根据我的经验来说，我一直觉得拥有这个学位很有用。

sentences.en: And I think for me, I can only draw from my experience, I've always found that useful to have.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这些知识在目前的培训中一直非常有用。

sentences.en: For me, that's always been really useful knowledge to apply on training so far.
sentences.zh: 但很多人不会有这个学位。

sentences.en: And lots of people won't have that.
sentences.zh: 很多人没有，可能是因为他们的学位由于某种原因没有获得 BPS 认证。

sentences.en: And lots of people won't have it because maybe the degree that they had wasn't BPS accredited for one reason or another.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一种非常难以平衡的张力。

sentences.en: So I think it's a really difficult tension to hold.
sentences.zh: 但这些就是当你拥有照护经历时会遇到的一些障碍，当然，最大的障碍之一是情感和支持网络，

sentences.en: But those are kind of a few of the barriers when your care experience and, you know, of course, one of the largest ones is the emotional and the kind of support networks,
sentences.zh: 因为培训真的会很辛苦。

sentences.en: because training can be really hard.
sentences.zh: 很多有照护经历和疏远家庭的人不会有这些支持。

sentences.en: And a lot of care experience and estranged people won't have that.
sentences.zh: 但这些只是一部分。

sentences.en: But those are those are a few.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能公正地表达出来。

sentences.en: And I hope I've given them justice.
sentences.zh: 但肯定还有很多很多。

sentences.en: But there will be so many more.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 听你这么说，我想到了一些，我不知道，也许是一些平行的事情，或者说，甚至不是平行，而是相反的事情，比如，

sentences.en: And just listening to you, I was kind of thinking of, I don't know, maybe some parallels that were just well, not even parallels, like opposites, really, like,
sentences.zh: 我以前为了做早期的求职工作，不得不很早起床。

sentences.en: I used to have to get up really early to do some of my early aspiring jobs.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名家庭护理员，这是我做过最好的工作，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: So I was a home carer, best job ever loved it.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，你必须在人们吃早餐前起床。

sentences.en: But obviously, you're having to get up before people have their breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我起得很早。

sentences.en: So I was getting up really early.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸也会早起。

sentences.en: My dad would get up early.
sentences.zh: 我们把那顿饭称为我们的第一顿早餐，我们在一起吃的第一顿早餐。

sentences.en: And he we call our first breakfast, really our first breakfast together.
sentences.zh: 然后我就出门去把我的客户从床上叫醒，给他们准备早餐。

sentences.en: Then I'd go off and and go and get like all my clients up out of bed and give them their breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我会回家吃我自己的第二顿早餐。

sentences.en: Then I'd come home for like myself, my second breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 那时我爸爸已经去上班了。

sentences.en: My dad had gone to work by then.
sentences.zh: 但那是有人愿意花时间陪我。

sentences.en: But it was someone that just wanted to spend that time with me.
sentences.zh: 当我长大时，在那之前，我的第一份工作是在米尔顿凯恩斯的 Boots 工作。

sentences.en: And when I was growing up, before that was older than I, my first job was working in Boots in Milton Keynes.
sentences.zh: 我当时一时兴起决定申请，因为我显然需要钱，而且我觉得这份工作听起来不错。

sentences.en: But I just decided on a whim to apply because I obviously wanted some money and I thought the job sounded good.
sentences.zh: 但它离我住的地方有 10 英里远，我理所当然地认为我父母会在周六和周日开车接送我。

sentences.en: But it was 10 miles away from where I lived and just expected that my parents will drive me there and back on a Saturday and a Sunday.
sentences.zh: 即使是那样，对于一个有照护经历的人来说，你未必有那种陪伴，也未必有人能当你的司机。

sentences.en: And even even that, like for someone who's care experienced, you haven't necessarily got that companionship and you haven't got someone that is your taxi necessarily.
sentences.zh: 在那些早期工作中，甚至连起步都更难，更不用说薪水还少得可怜。

sentences.en: Like it's it's just harder to even get started in those early roles, let alone the pay being terrible.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 你知道，肯定会有一些后勤方面的问题，比如“这该怎么运作？”

sentences.en: And, you know, there are definitely some of those logistic kind of how how is this going to work?
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我搬到了苏塞克斯中部，这样我就能在苏塞克斯找到任何工作。

sentences.en: And, you know, for me, I've I moved to kind of mid Sussex so I could get any job in Sussex.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能够学会开车。

sentences.en: And I'm fortunate enough to have been able to learn to drive.
sentences.zh: 当我 17 岁时，我就想，好吧，去学开车吧，尽管当时我住在伦敦。

sentences.en: And I kind of it was something that when I turned 17, I was like, right, let's get driving, even though at that point I lived in London.
sentences.zh: 我真的不需要开车。

sentences.en: I really didn't need to drive.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我想做这件事。

sentences.en: I just thought I want to do this.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果我们也考虑我们的交叉性，我身份中有很多部分相比其他人是享有特权的。

sentences.en: And, you know, if we think also about our intersectionalities, I there are many parts of my identity that are privileged compared to other people.
sentences.zh: 比如作为男性，白人男性，而且住在伦敦，

sentences.en: But you might have also got to a point where you're feeling burnt out, you're feeling quite tired and it's OK to feel that way.

sentences.en: oh, I can't get a bus or I can't get a train.

sentences.en: So it's like it was always important to you to be able to to be able to be in the driving seat metaphorically and really literally.
sentences.zh: 所以，能够从隐喻和字面意义上掌握自己的方向盘，对你来说一直很重要。

sentences.en: That's the word, isn't it, to be able to take you in the direction you wanted to go,

sentences.en: because maybe so much of your story has been dependent on on others having the time or having the interest or or caring enough.
sentences.zh: 因为也许你的故事中有太多部分依赖于他人是否有时间、是否有兴趣或是否足够关心。

sentences.en: And actually, you were like, I haven't I can't take that risk.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，你的想法是，我不能冒那个险。

sentences.en: I can't take that gamble.
sentences.zh: 我不能去赌那个运气。

sentences.en: I need to I need to be in, you know, in control of my own destiny.
sentences.zh: 我需要，你知道，掌控我自己的命运。

sentences.en: So I love that you learned to drive and that you you're like this.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢你学会了开车，而且你表现得像这样。

sentences.en: This is happening.
sentences.zh: 这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: And actually, just before we hit record, you know, I asked you how old you are.
sentences.zh: 其实，就在我们开始录音之前，你知道，我问了你多大。

sentences.en: I hope that was OK that I did that.
sentences.zh: 希望我这样做没关系。

sentences.en: And you told me that when you started training, you were 23.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我你开始培训时是23岁。

sentences.en: And I said, well, I think you're the youngest trainee I've ever known in that case.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，那我觉得你是我认识的最年轻的学员了。

sentences.en: But you don't seem 24 now.
sentences.zh: 但你现在看起来不像24岁。

sentences.en: You seem you seem older than your years.
sentences.zh: 你看起来比实际年龄要成熟。

sentences.en: And I think when you've been through adverse experiences or even just different experiences where you've had to hold your shit together a bit more
sentences.zh: 我觉得当你经历过逆境，或者仅仅是经历过一些不同的事情，让你不得不更加克制自己，

sentences.en: and be more self-controlled and drive your own agenda, I think that just would you agree?
sentences.zh: 更加自律并掌控自己的人生目标时，我觉得——你同意吗？

sentences.en: It ages you, makes you grow up quick.
sentences.zh: 这会让你显得成熟，让你成长得很快。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百同意。

sentences.en: And it's it's kind of a socialization process.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一种社会化过程。

sentences.en: I suppose I would see it as to some extent that you kind of you have to walk the walk and talk the talk.
sentences.zh: 我想在某种程度上，我会把它看作是你必须言行一致。

sentences.en: You know, you've got to make sure that you can kind of show people that you've you've got that you've got that kind of sense that, you know, you can do this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你必须确保你能向人们展示你拥有那种……那种你能够做到这一点的心态。

sentences.en: And I think it was a really lovely observation to hear that, you know, how you viewed kind of my experience of coming into it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得听到你如何看待我刚开始时的经历，是一个非常可爱的观察。

sentences.en: And I think it's really true that, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这确实是真的，你知道，

sentences.en: I had to develop this real kind of go with the hyper independence that often we will see people develop when they've had adverse experiences.
sentences.zh: 我不得不发展出一种超强的独立性，我们经常看到人们在经历过逆境后会发展出这种特质。

sentences.en: And sometimes it can be really disadvantageous, but also it can it can help you through so many different things.
sentences.zh: 有时这可能非常不利，但它也能帮助你度过许多不同的难关。

sentences.en: And I do think that some of me being in this position now comes from not being able to take the risk on other people and having to go with that independence and having to kind of really hold on to myself and kind of develop that secure attachment to myself and my knowledge that I can do this,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我现在处于这个位置，部分原因是我无法在别人身上冒险，不得不保持那种独立，不得不真正坚持自我，并建立起对自己和对自己能力的坚定依恋，即我知道我能做到，

sentences.en: which is it's been a really hard journey.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常艰难的旅程。

sentences.en: And naturally, there are times where you doubt yourself and you think, oh, I really wish someone was there to especially, you know, when you might be feeling,
sentences.zh: 当然，有时你会怀疑自己，你会想，哦，我真希望有人能在那里，特别是，你知道，当你可能感到，

sentences.en: as I mentioned earlier, burnt out or sick or, you know, whatever's coming up for you.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前提到的，精疲力竭、生病，或者，你知道，任何发生在你身上的事情时。

sentences.en: You just want someone there to just make it easier.
sentences.zh: 你只是希望有人在那里让事情变得更容易。

sentences.en: And sometimes a lot of the time, people with care experience won't have that.
sentences.zh: 而有时，很多时候，有护理经历的人不会有那种支持。

sentences.en: And so you do have to develop that kind of ability to hold yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实必须培养那种自我支撑的能力。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you go into training and you start to become a clinical psychologist, you're on that pathway.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当你进入培训并开始成为一名临床心理学家时，你就走上了那条道路。

sentences.en: Part of that for me has been about leaning on my fellow trainees and leaning on the support that the course provides and knowing that.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这其中的一部分是依靠我的学员同伴，依靠课程提供的支持，并了解这一点。

sentences.en: It's been hard to get here and you've had to make quite a lot of sacrifice to get here.
sentences.zh: 走到这一步很不容易，你不得不做出相当多的牺牲才能来到这里。

sentences.en: But now is the time that you can kind of do what you haven't been able to do, which is lean on people,
sentences.zh: 但现在是时候做你以前无法做到的事情了，那就是依靠别人，

sentences.en: feel the support and kind of feel the love that other people have for you that feels really foreign sometimes.
sentences.zh: 感受支持，感受别人对你的爱，这有时感觉真的很陌生。

sentences.en: But it's it's usually always been there with your chosen family and friends.
sentences.zh: 但它通常一直都在，与你选择的家人和朋友在一起。

sentences.en: But maybe it's been harder to feel and you've had to kind of not take the risk and just do things alone.
sentences.zh: 但也许这更难感受到，你不得不不去冒险，只是独自做事情。

sentences.en: And now you don't have to.
sentences.zh: 而现在你不需要这样了。

sentences.en: So that's really been my experience of getting on to training.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我进入培训的真实经历。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's a really valuable reflection.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是一个非常有价值的思考。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's that really powerful idea of forever people, you know, and it's whether you've ever really allowed yourself to to feel like someone is a forever person.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一个关于“永远的人”的非常有力的想法，你知道，这取决于你是否真正允许自己去感觉某人是“永远的人”。

sentences.en: And and if someone tells you they are, it's whether you really can put both feet in there and feel that or whether you always sort of slightly ready to to look after yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果有人告诉你他们是，关键在于你是否真的能全身心投入去感受，还是说你总是稍微准备着去照顾好自己。

sentences.en: And ultimately, as a mummy and as a wife and as a as a psychologist, I would hope that there does become that comfortability with that sense of family and connection and, you know,
sentences.zh: 最终，作为一名母亲、妻子和心理学家，我希望人们能对那种家庭感和联系感感到舒适，你知道，

sentences.en: genuine friendships where you know that you can take as well as as well as give and that that's OK.
sentences.zh: 那种真诚的友谊，你知道你可以索取也可以给予，而且这样做是可以的。

sentences.en: You don't always need to be the fixer or the helper that it's OK to say, I'm really struggling at the moment.
sentences.zh: 你不需要总是做那个解决问题的人或帮助者，说“我现在真的很挣扎”是可以的。

sentences.en: Could you could you come to my house instead or could could we just speak more regularly on the phone or can you can we do this?
sentences.zh: 你能来我家吗，或者我们可以更频繁地通电话吗，或者我们可以这样做吗？

sentences.en: Can you just be my friend like and I, you know, this isn't you don't necessarily need to open up about this.
sentences.zh: 你能只做我的朋友吗？而且，你知道，这并不是说你一定要敞开心扉谈论这些。

sentences.en: This might be feel too exposing, but I would just ultimately want for you and for anyone that's care experienced to be able to have that deep exhale.

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Where you're like you have that contentment, you've got your favorite blanket and actually the people around you feel like they are on your team.
sentences.zh: 那种你感到满足，有你最喜欢的毯子，而且周围的人让你觉得他们和你站在同一队的感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And I mean, so I have so many parallels with that experience of kind of now is I can exhale now and I can kind of relax a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我与那种经历有太多的共鸣，那种“我现在可以呼气了，我可以稍微放松一点了”的感觉。

sentences.en: They say when you get on the course, you're no longer in competition with your peers and you do really feel that.
sentences.zh: 人们说当你进入课程时，你就不再与同伴竞争了，你确实能感觉到这一点。

sentences.en: And you kind of feel this community, which I've grown to feel slightly more comfortable with, but certainly as well.
sentences.zh: 你会感觉到这种社区感，我已经变得稍微适应了一些，当然也确实如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm also thinking as well for most practitioners and most people on my course as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我也在想，对于大多数从业者和我课程上的大多数人来说也是如此。

sentences.en: There will be some form of lived experience that they've had that kind of touches a part of them when we're doing the lecture content
sentences.zh: 他们会有某种形式的生活经历，当我们在讲课内容时，会触动他们的一部分，

sentences.en: or something comes up in a relationship that they've had outside or kind of in therapy with someone.
sentences.zh: 或者在他们外部的关系中，或者在与某人的治疗过程中出现了一些事情。

sentences.en: It can be really difficult for so many different people.
sentences.zh: 这对许多不同的人来说可能真的很困难。

sentences.en: And I think this is something that applies beyond care experience, but is equally as important as.
sentences.zh: 我认为这不仅仅适用于护理经历，而且同样重要。

sentences.en: And I suppose for me, my experience has definitely been difficult.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，我的经历绝对是困难的。

sentences.en: I've had some kind of important people in my life.
sentences.zh: 我生命中有一些重要的人。

sentences.en: I've had some family and friends that have always fortunately been there for me.
sentences.zh: 我有家人和朋友，幸运的是他们一直都在我身边。

sentences.en: But I've also had people that haven't been there for me.
sentences.zh: 但我也遇到过没有支持我的人。

sentences.en: And I think when you're at such a young age as, you know, using the knowledge that we know.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为当你还那么年轻时，你知道，利用我们所知道的知识。

sentences.en: Naturally, if you'd kind of balance the odds, the body and the brain tells you it's it's too risky to trust anyone.
sentences.zh: 自然地，如果你权衡一下胜算，身体和大脑会告诉你，信任任何人风险太大。

sentences.zh: 如果我以前经历过这种事，它很可能会再次发生。

sentences.en: And I can't take that risk.
sentences.zh: 我不能冒那个险。

sentences.en: So I suppose for me, it's it's been about kind of training my body and training my brain to go now it's OK.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对我来说，这关乎训练我的身体和大脑去想“现在没关系了”。

sentences.en: And it's been OK for a while, but kind of particularly now when you've got the support,
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况已经好了一段时间了，但特别是现在当你有了支持，

sentences.zh: 你有了这个真正切实的网络，你可以从那种战斗或逃跑、那种威胁系统中走出来。

sentences.en: And you can just be and feel what being with and connecting with feels like.
sentences.zh: 你可以只是存在，并感受与人相处和连接的感觉。

sentences.en: And so that's been a really important part of my journey of kind of developing those longer standing relationships with people that you can give and take from.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我旅程中非常重要的一部分，即与那些你可以给予和索取的人建立更长久的关系。

sentences.en: And I was, you know, last weekend, I was up in Wolverhampton with one of my friends driving all the way there and back,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，上周末，我和我的一个朋友在伍尔弗汉普顿，开车往返全程，

sentences.en: which I was more than happy to do because she wanted to pick up a new puppy that she had found.
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意这样做，因为她想去接一只她找到的新小狗。

sentences.en: And it's kind of these relationships that you develop that are linked with the journey that you've been on, you know, in clinical psychology,
sentences.zh: 这种你建立的关系与你在临床心理学中经历的旅程是相关联的，你知道，

sentences.en: but also applicable outside that kind of train you without you realising.
sentences.zh: 但也适用于那些在你没意识到时训练你的外部事物。

sentences.en: It's kind of an implicit or kind of unknown process that, you know, as you grow older and as you have this security and the support network, you start to feel differently.
sentences.zh: 这是一种隐性的或未知的过程，你知道，随着你年龄增长，随着你拥有这种安全感和支持网络，你开始有不同的感觉。

sentences.en: And I'm really grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常感激。

sentences.en: I hope you get to spend some time with that puppy.
sentences.zh: 希望你能花点时间和那只小狗在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, because it's a pattern matching part of our brain that's kind of driven by the amygdala that's looking for threat, looking for danger.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为这是我们大脑中由杏仁核驱动的模式匹配部分，它在寻找威胁，寻找危险。

sentences.en: And it's it kind of takes you from being that bird in the garden that's kind of peck.
sentences.zh: 它让你从花园里那只鸟变成那种啄食的状态。

sentences.en: Look, look, look, look, look, look, look, look, look, peck.
sentences.zh: 看，看，看，看，看，看，看，看，看，啄。

sentences.en: Look, look, look, look, always looking for that threat and that that kind of risk to self to actually a really lovely example.
sentences.zh: 看，看，看，看，总是寻找那种威胁和对自我的风险，这其实是一个非常可爱的例子。

sentences.en: I was watching on TikTok yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天在TikTok上看到的。

sentences.en: Oh,
sentences.zh: 哦，

sentences.en: can't you lose days on TikTok sometimes where someone has trained two robins to come into her home and feed there and be around her and land on her hand and her garden and I can a garden furniture.
sentences.zh: 你有时会在TikTok上浪费时间，有人训练了两只知更鸟进入她的家，在那里喂食，待在她身边，落在她的手上、花园里和花园家具上。

sentences.en: And and she's done that over time by being a safe person,
sentences.zh: 她通过成为一个安全的人，随着时间的推移做到了这一点，

sentences.en: by picking actually the type of food that she realizes the robin likes best to help the robin know actually I'm a safe person.
sentences.zh: 通过挑选她意识到知更鸟最喜欢的食物，来帮助知更鸟知道“其实我是一个安全的人”。

sentences.en: And she said something really powerful.
sentences.zh: 她说了一句非常有力量的话。

sentences.en: She said, I've realized from all the research I've done about robins that actually the average lifespan is about 13 months.
sentences.zh: 她说，我从关于知更鸟的研究中意识到，其实它们的平均寿命大约是13个月。

sentences.en: And that means that I might not be with these robins for much longer.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我可能不会和这些知更鸟在一起太久了。

sentences.en: But actually, biologically, they can get to be 20 years.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，从生物学上讲，它们可以活到20岁。

sentences.en: It's just that they rarely do because they have such stressful experiences where they don't have enough food.
sentences.zh: 只是它们很少能活到那个岁数，因为它们经历了太多的压力，没有足够的食物。

sentences.en: And I think for me, there's that parallel, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，这里有一个相似之处，不是吗？

sentences.en: That if you find you're safe and for other people, life can be so much more comfortable and ultimately you will be less stressed and you will live longer.
sentences.zh: 如果你发现自己是安全的，对其他人来说，生活可以舒适得多，最终你会减少压力，活得更长。

sentences.en: I really hope so.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望如此。

sentences.en: Sorry to compare you to robins, but it just felt it felt really powerfully important there.
sentences.zh: 抱歉把你和知更鸟做比较，但这感觉真的很重要。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And I felt myself and I said, wow, when you're telling the story, because a birds are just so skittish, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 我当时也觉得，哇，当你讲这个故事的时候，因为鸟儿真的很胆小，不是吗？

sentences.en: They never come up to you.
sentences.zh: 它们从不靠近你。

sentences.en: They always fly away.
sentences.zh: 它们总是飞走。

sentences.en: And you don't often hear that story of kind of developing a relationship like that.
sentences.zh: 你很少听到那种建立这样关系的经历。

sentences.en: And, you know, it is a good comparison to make.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是一个很好的比较。

sentences.en: It's a really good analogy, because I think there are times where, as you say, the amygdala sees someone or something or what could have been a positive experience as a threat.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的类比，因为我认为正如你所说，有时杏仁核会将某人、某事或本可以是积极的经历视为威胁。

sentences.en: And so naturally, it's not something that we explore, but through trying time and time again and kind of training our body and our brain to notice what else, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以自然地，这不是我们去探索的东西，但通过一次又一次地尝试，通过训练我们的身体和大脑去注意其他事物，你知道，

sentences.en: are there safe parts about this experience or this person?
sentences.zh: 这段经历或这个人身上有安全的部分吗？

sentences.en: And can we think more about those and feel those slightly more deeply?
sentences.zh: 我们可以更多地思考这些，并更深地感受它们吗？

sentences.en: Eventually you can get used to it.
sentences.zh: 最终你可以习惯它。

sentences.en: And I suppose for me, in my experience, it's it has been a long time, but definitely I really like that comparison to a robin and their beautiful birds.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，在我的经历中，这确实花了一段很长的时间，但我真的很喜欢那个与知更鸟的比较，它们是美丽的鸟儿。

sentences.en: So I'm going to take that as a compliment as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我也会把它当作一种赞美。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And before we hit record, you know, you were telling me that actually your experience in the care system started incredibly young.
sentences.zh: 在录音之前，你知道，你告诉我其实你在护理系统的经历开始得非常早。

sentences.en: I think you said you were in the year one.
sentences.zh: 我想你说你是在一年级时进入的。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, that's just a lot.
sentences.zh: 那，你知道，那真的很多。

sentences.en: That's a lot for you to have had to to bear from a young age.
sentences.zh: 你从很小的时候就不得不承受这么多。

sentences.en: And I'm just, you know, as a mummy, I'm just really sad that happened to you.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道，作为一名母亲，我真的很难过那发生在你身上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And your experiences have been different.
sentences.zh: 你的经历与众不同。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not suggesting that everybody that's been raised by their families have had gold standard, a treatment like a star treatment because they haven't, have they?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我并不是说每个被家人抚养长大的人都得到了黄金标准的待遇，像明星一样的待遇，因为他们没有，不是吗？

sentences.en: And I know that kind of in the care system recently,
sentences.zh: 我知道最近在护理系统中，

sentences.en: there'd been a change because actually it was always felt that it was in the child's best interest to to retain a relationship with their biological parent.
sentences.zh: 发生了一些变化，因为实际上人们一直认为，保留与亲生父母的关系符合儿童的最大利益。

sentences.en: And I think I'm right in saying that's changed recently because even children that have been born as a result of rape
sentences.zh: 我想我没说错，最近这已经改变了，因为即使是强奸导致的出生儿童，

sentences.en: have sometimes been asked to maintain a relationship with with their birth father.
sentences.zh: 有时也被要求与他们的生父保持联系。

sentences.en: Well, in actual fact, that's not even, you know, just a whole host of complicated things ever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，那甚至不是，你知道，只是一堆复杂的事情而已。

sentences.en: I believe it's changed so that so that you don't have to always maintain that and that the child's voice can be listened to more.
sentences.zh: 我相信它已经改变了，所以你不必总是维持那种关系，孩子的意见可以得到更多的倾听。

sentences.en: But I just think it is harder to have been through what you've been through.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得经历过你所经历的一切确实更难。

sentences.en: That's in a nutshell what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，这就是我想说的。

sentences.en: And as a mummy of two boys, I'm just, you know, I'm really moved by what you've been through, both as a child, as an adolescent and currently.
sentences.zh: 作为两个男孩的母亲，我真的被你所经历的一切所感动，无论是作为孩子、青少年还是现在。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think you are right in saying that I think there have been some kind of policy reviews that really did look into the experiences of children currently in care.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你说得对，我想确实有一些政策审查真正深入研究了目前在护理中儿童的经历。

sentences.en: And I think you are right in saying that that's now no longer kind of a prerequisite that you must have contact with family.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你说得对，现在这不再是一个必须与家人保持联系的前提条件了。

sentences.en: And oftentimes, you know, in my experience, and I'm happy to share some of this that, you know, as you said, I came into care when I was in year one.
sentences.zh: 而且通常，你知道，根据我的经验，我很乐意分享其中的一些，你知道，正如你所说，我是在一年级时进入护理系统的。

sentences.en: So it was sort of around five, six years old.
sentences.zh: 所以大约是在五六岁的时候。

sentences.en: And then I was in care from a foster carer for about four years.
sentences.zh: 然后我在寄养照顾下待了大约四年。

sentences.en: And then I went to get adopted from London all the way to Wakefield.
sentences.zh: 后来我从伦敦一路被领养到了韦克菲尔德。

sentences.en: And that didn't work out after a few months.
sentences.zh: 但几个月后，那次领养没能成功。

sentences.en: So then I came back to the same foster carer.
sentences.zh: 于是我又回到了原来的寄养家庭。

sentences.en: Thank goodness.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地。

sentences.en: We know what, you know, the impact of continuity can have.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，你知道，连续性会产生什么样的影响。

sentences.en: And the same therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 还有同一位治疗师。

sentences.en: So, you know, two really important cornerstones of, you know, my early life that remained the same through a difficult time.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在我早年生活中，这两个非常重要的基石在困难时期始终如一。

sentences.en: And I suppose for me, through that part of my experience, through going to be adopted, I had often said, has anyone stopped to ask me how I feel?
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，在那段经历中，在准备被领养的过程中，我经常问，有没有人停下来问问我的感受？

sentences.en: Nobody's asked me what I think and whether I'm happy with this.
sentences.zh: 没有人问过我的想法，也没有人问过我对此是否满意。

sentences.en: And I suppose it speaks to this wider kind of pressure that's on systems nowadays that, you know, there aren't enough foster carers.
sentences.zh: 我想这反映了当今系统所面临的更广泛的压力，你知道，寄养家庭不够多。

sentences.en: There are, you know, the caring profession is really on its knees.
sentences.zh: 你知道，护理行业确实已经不堪重负了。

sentences.en: There's no one.
sentences.zh: 没有人了。

sentences.en: There's not many people.
sentences.zh: 没多少人了。

sentences.en: And I think it can be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很难。

sentences.en: And, you know, as you were saying as well, we're not saying that all families that, you know, all people that live with their, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，正如你刚才所说，我们并不是说所有家庭，你知道，所有与他们，你知道，

sentences.en: chosen or biological family have better experiences.
sentences.zh: 选择的家庭或亲生家庭生活在一起的人，都有更好的经历。

sentences.en: Definitely there are really difficult times.
sentences.zh: 当然，确实会有非常困难的时期。

sentences.en: And I suppose the difference that really for me feels quite important with care experience and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，对于有照护经历的人和，你知道，

sentences.en: individuals that have been estranged is that direct or tenuous contact with these systems that can add a level of pressure and a level of difficulty.
sentences.zh: 与家庭疏远的人来说，对我而言感觉非常重要的区别在于，与这些系统的直接或微弱的接触，可能会增加一层压力和困难。

sentences.en: And I suppose, you know, and it's really lovely to feel that kind of motherly instinct that you've got.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，能感受到你身上那种母性本能真的很美好。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's something that I've definitely experienced a lot of and through systems as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这也是我通过系统确实经历过很多的事情。

sentences.en: And the way that systems like to make sure that they're doing their best to kind of ask you lots of questions, to collect data, to ask questionnaires.
sentences.zh: 系统喜欢确保他们尽最大努力去问你很多问题，收集数据，进行问卷调查。

sentences.en: And when I was growing up, I think there was a cyclical pattern of having what were once called, and I'm not sure whether they still are, but lack reviews and reviews,
sentences.zh: 我成长过程中，我想有一种循环模式，就是进行所谓的——我不确定现在是否还这样叫——审查和再审查，

sentences.en: I think as well.
sentences.zh: 我想也是这样。

sentences.en: And as part of that process, these are meetings where you kind of review how things are going, how you're feeling, how your school experience is going.
sentences.zh: 作为该过程的一部分，这些会议旨在评估事情进展如何，你的感受如何，学校生活如何。

sentences.en: And part of that is filling out these really boring, really annoying questionnaires.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分就是填写这些非常枯燥、非常烦人的问卷。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Because that's how the systems in place at that time needed to be able to see how they were doing and how cared for you were.
sentences.zh: 因为那是当时现行的系统需要了解他们做得如何，以及你受到了怎样的照顾。

sentences.en: And of course, that adds another layer of difficulty onto it.
sentences.zh: 当然，这又增加了一层困难。

sentences.en: For me, I kind of got to the point where I was like, I cannot be bothered to sit on top of homework, which I probably wasn't doing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我到了那种地步，觉得我没心思去应付作业，我可能本来也没在做。

sentences.en: So then I have to do one of these long questionnaires.
sentences.zh: 所以我还得去填这些冗长的问卷。

sentences.en: And I admittedly, at one point when I was a little bit older, I started just putting random answers that I knew, I think I learnt the system.
sentences.zh: 我承认，在我大一点的时候，我开始随便填答案，我想我摸透了这个系统。

sentences.en: And I kind of knew that if I put something down that indicated a level of risk or something going on that, you know, they might panic.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果我写下一些表明有风险或有问题的内容，你知道，他们可能会恐慌。

sentences.en: And I kind of did that at points to just kind of show that this is not this isn't a way of caring.
sentences.zh: 我有时确实会这样做，只是为了表明这根本不是一种关怀。

sentences.en: This is another responsibility, another level of difficulty.
sentences.zh: 这只是另一种责任，另一层困难。

sentences.en: So I think the difference between care experience and difficult family experiences, which are just as important,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，照护经历与困难的家庭经历之间的区别——两者同样重要，

sentences.en: particularly for practitioners where things can be replicated in therapeutic relationships, is the relationship that care experience people have with systeMs.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于从业者而言，因为治疗关系中可能会重现这些经历——在于有照护经历的人与系统之间的关系。

sentences.en: So for me, coming into the NHS and coming into kind of my training experience, it's been really important to hold on to my relationship,
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，进入国民医疗服务体系（NHS）并开始我的培训经历，保持我的关系非常重要，

sentences.en: my previous relationships with these systems and know that they might touch parts of me that feel really uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我与这些系统之前的关系，并且知道它们可能会触动我内心感到非常不舒服的部分。

sentences.en: And, you know, is that something I'm ready to do?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是我准备好去面对的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And if you are in a relationship then with your supervisor where they they do want to be quite maternal,
sentences.zh: 如果你和你的导师之间存在一种关系，而他们确实想要表现得相当母性，

sentences.en: is that their personal style or is this is that what your relationship with them is eliciting?
sentences.zh: 那是他们个人的风格，还是你与他们的关系诱发了这种表现？

sentences.en: And for me, I would say it probably is my personal style.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我会说这可能就是我的个人风格。

sentences.en: So I do.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实会。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我确实会。

sentences.en: I do mother.
sentences.zh: 我确实会像母亲一样。

sentences.en: I do mother people.
sentences.zh: 我确实会像母亲一样照顾人。

sentences.en: It was observed just at the weekend when I was with a load of my qualified psychologist friends, you know, they were all going off on their train journeys.
sentences.zh: 就在周末，我和一群合格的心理学家朋友在一起时，大家观察到了这一点，你知道，他们都要去赶火车。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, does anyone want any kombucha?
sentences.zh: 我就说，哦，有人想喝康普茶吗？

sentences.en: I've got some in my bag.
sentences.zh: 我包里有一些。

sentences.en: I was like giving out these tins of kombucha.
sentences.zh: 我当时在分发这些康普茶罐装饮料。

sentences.en: And one of my friends I've known her since were assistants when you're taking care of us, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 我认识的一位朋友说，我们还是助理的时候你就这样，你在照顾我们，对吧？

sentences.en: You're giving us gifts to make sure we're going to be OK.
sentences.zh: 你在给我们礼物，确保我们一切都会好好的。

sentences.en: And I was like, yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，我是。

sentences.en: But also it's really tasty.
sentences.zh: 但它也确实很好喝。

sentences.en: So go and drink it.
sentences.zh: 所以去喝吧。

sentences.en: It'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 没事的。

sentences.en: But that is just my style.
sentences.zh: 但这确实就是我的风格。

sentences.en: You know, when I had an assistant when I was in the NHS, we'd come and have supervision at my house and I'd make a hot chocolate with cream and marshmallows.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在NHS当助理时，我们会来我家进行督导，我会做热巧克力，加奶油和棉花糖。

sentences.en: Like that is just my style.
sentences.zh: 这确实就是我的风格。

sentences.en: Whereas if you were having that, you might think, oh, you know, she's trying to mother me.
sentences.zh: 而如果你经历这些，你可能会想，哦，你知道，她想当我的母亲。

sentences.en: And it's like, well, no, because, you know, my previous assistant was was very well mothered.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，不，因为，你知道，我之前的助理被照顾得非常好。

sentences.en: And this is this is just my style.
sentences.zh: 这只是我的风格。

sentences.en: But also maybe there's something to reflect on there.
sentences.zh: 但也可能有一些值得反思的地方。

sentences.en: You know, what what what would it be like if I wasn't if I wasn't mothering my assistants?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我不像母亲一样照顾我的助理，会是什么样子？

sentences.en: You know, every day is a school day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，活到老学到老。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's it's.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，它是……

sentences.en: And I think thinking about some of my trainee supervisors, some of them were really nurturing.
sentences.zh: 我想起我的一些培训督导，他们中有些人真的很会照顾人。

sentences.en: Some of them were a bit more hands off.
sentences.zh: 有些人则比较放手。

sentences.en: Some of them, you know, I learned a lot from.
sentences.zh: 有些人，你知道，我从他们身上学到了很多。

sentences.en: I think all of them I learned a lot from some of them I've kept in my life.
sentences.zh: 我想我从他们所有人身上都学到了很多，有些人我一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: Some of them I haven't like.
sentences.zh: 有些人则没有，就像……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And another reflection like biochemically, sometimes I think we just sometimes meet someone and you get on really well, don't you?
sentences.zh: 还有一点反思，从生物化学的角度来看，有时我觉得我们只是遇到了某个人，然后相处得很好，不是吗？

sentences.en: And you feel you feel comfortable with them.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得和他们在一起很舒服。

sentences.en: And listening to what you said about when you met your adoptive family, like there's that sense of what was that like for you as a young person?
sentences.zh: 听了你说的关于见到领养家庭的事，那种感觉对年轻时的你来说是什么样的？

sentences.en: Like, do you just suddenly go from hi to like, this is my new mom?
sentences.zh: 就像，你是突然从“你好”直接变成“这是我的新妈妈”吗？

sentences.en: Like and when do we ask for for the child?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候会去询问孩子的感受？

sentences.en: When do we give them that safe space to to check in with how it's feeling, whether you think this will be viable or whether everyone's kind of trying to jolly you up and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候给他们那个安全的空间，去确认他们的感受，去问你是否认为这行得通，还是每个人都在试图让你开心，你知道，

sentences.en: smooth it over with some like, you know, plaster to make it all work and not have these cracks turn into into crevices.
sentences.zh: 用一些创可贴把它掩盖过去，让一切看起来都好，而不让这些裂缝变成深渊。

sentences.en: Does that kind of make sense, Jacob?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗，Jacob？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对说得通。

sentences.en: And something I've always held in mind is that that we all have people might think differently.
sentences.zh: 我一直记在心里的一点是，我们所有人——人们可能想法不同——

sentences.en: But I think that we all kind of have this in a child that we kind of are parenting day to day that will influence our relationships.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们内心都有一个孩子，我们每天都在养育它，这会影响我们的人际关系。

sentences.en: And, you know, another way of thinking about it is the internal working model from Bowlby's attachment theory.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，另一种思考方式是鲍尔比依恋理论中的内部工作模型。

sentences.en: And, you know, for people that might not be aware of what that is, it's kind of this sense of a model of relationships
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对于可能不知道那是什么的人来说，这是一种关于人际关系的模型感，

sentences.en: and how they should be and what we should accept and and how relationships have therefore been in our past that have taught us what to accept.
sentences.zh: 关于关系应该是什么样，我们应该接受什么，以及我们过去的关系如何教会了我们该接受什么。

sentences.en: And I suppose and how to be in relationships as well.
sentences.zh: 我想，还有如何处理人际关系。

sentences.en: And I suppose for me coming into kind of supervisory relationships as well, I've had a real mix.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，进入督导关系时，我也有过各种各样的体验。

sentences.en: I've definitely had some really kind of nurturing and motherly supervision.
sentences.zh: 我确实有过非常滋养和母性的督导。

sentences.en: And I've also had some really kind of clinical supervision that's kind of more about the work and and what are we doing with this case?
sentences.zh: 我也经历过非常临床的督导，更多是关于工作，关于我们如何处理这个案例？

sentences.en: And and how is this feeling?
sentences.zh: 以及，这感觉如何？

sentences.en: But I I think underpinning all of this is my belief that we all have an inner child that will be influencing our relationships.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这一切的基础是我的信念，即我们内心都有一个孩子，它会影响我们的人际关系。

sentences.en: And naturally, sometimes these children want to share, sometimes they don't want to share, sometimes they get along and sometimes they don't.
sentences.zh: 自然地，有时这些孩子想分享，有时不想，有时他们相处得来，有时则不然。

sentences.en: And whether or not it comes out kind of explicitly and we see these things coming out, they will still be there,
sentences.zh: 无论它是否显露出来，无论我们是否看到这些东西表现出来，它们依然存在，

sentences.en: whether or not we've got this felt sense that this relationship feels safe.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否有一种“这段关系感觉安全”的直觉。

sentences.en: And I think it's about, you know, looking under the surface about what the context is and why.
sentences.zh: 我认为关键在于，去探究表面之下，背景是什么，为什么会这样。

sentences.en: So for me, in that particular experience, it didn't feel safe to be with these adoptive parents because you're right.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，在那次特定的经历中，和这些养父母在一起感觉并不安全，因为你是对的。

sentences.en: And it felt like I was being chivied up to kind of, you know, this is a really good thing.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我被催促着去接受，你知道，这是一件非常好的事情。

sentences.en: And but who's it good for?
sentences.zh: 但这对谁好呢？

sentences.en: Because no one asked me.
sentences.zh: 因为没人问过我。

sentences.en: It's good for the system that now there's another spot for a child to be looked after by my foster carer, which, you know, is a difficult thing anyway.
sentences.zh: 这对系统有好处，因为现在我的寄养家庭又腾出了一个位置来照顾另一个孩子，这本身就是一件困难的事情。

sentences.en: But really, that's what it comes down to, that, you know, there's another spot open.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，就是有一个位置空出来了。

sentences.en: So for the system, yes, it's a really good thing that now they can put a green tick and there's a good outcome that I've kind of been adopted.
sentences.zh: 所以对于系统来说，是的，这是一件好事，他们现在可以打个绿勾，这是一个好的结果，因为我被领养了。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is the goal.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是目标。

sentences.en: And actually, things aren't always as linear as that and and thinking about it in supervision and in clinical psychology as well.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，事情并不总是那么线性，在督导和临床心理学中思考这个问题也是如此。

sentences.en: These reflections around relationships and and kind of what we think relationships should be are so important for how we are with clients in the room and how we approach clients and how we show them empathy and kind of just relate on a on a personal as well as professional level.
sentences.zh: 这些关于关系的思考，以及我们认为关系应该是什么样的想法，对于我们在咨询室里如何对待来访者，如何接近他们，如何向他们展示同理心，以及如何在个人和专业层面上建立联系，都非常重要。

sentences.en: And in supervision as well.
sentences.zh: 在督导中也是如此。

sentences.en: And I think style comes into it in kind of bucket loads, whether or not someone's style feels right to you is is a completely valid point to hold.
sentences.zh: 我认为风格在其中起到了巨大的作用，无论一个人的风格是否让你感觉对路，这都是一个完全合理的观点。

sentences.en: And I think when you have a difficult experience with relationships, for me, I found it really hard to know, is this is this style?
sentences.zh: 我认为当你经历过困难的人际关系时，对我来说，我发现很难分辨，这是风格问题吗？

sentences.en: Or can I kind of question this?
sentences.zh: 还是我可以质疑这一点？

sentences.en: Can I approach this with a curious stance or is this my stuff coming out?
sentences.zh: 我可以带着好奇的态度去处理吗，还是我自己的问题在作祟？

sentences.en: That's kind of I just don't like it because it's it feels difficult and a part of me is being activated.
sentences.zh: 就是因为我感觉不舒服，觉得困难，我内心的一部分被激活了。

sentences.en: And I think growing into the profession and the more practice you have, you know, as we were talking about earlier,
sentences.zh: 我认为随着职业成长和实践经验的增加，你知道，正如我们之前谈到的，

sentences.en: the more your Robin becomes tamed and your amygdala sees fewer things as threats.
sentences.zh: 你的前额叶变得更加成熟，你的杏仁核将威胁视为威胁的情况也会减少。

sentences.en: And I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想。

sentences.en: This is why for me,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么对我来说，

sentences.en: I think it's really important to think about readiness for training and readiness for taking on that role as a trainee clinical psychologist and even taking on kind of responsible roles in caring professions.
sentences.zh: 我认为思考培训的准备程度，以及作为临床心理学实习生承担角色的准备程度，甚至在护理行业承担责任角色，都非常重要。

sentences.en: I think it's a it's a ongoing and continual process of kind of using and disseminating these kind of points of knowledge to ourselves and also kind of integrating our own experiences.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个持续不断的过程，即利用和传播这些知识点，同时整合我们自己的经验。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've listened to your podcast for a really long time and I know.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我听你的播客已经很长时间了，我知道。

sentences.en: And this is why I felt like this is a really perfect place for us to have this discussion, because I know.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我觉得这是一个完美的场所来进行这次讨论，因为我知道。

sentences.en: That your stance is making sure that people feel compassionate towards themselves and having that kind of holding that compassion and, you know,
sentences.zh: 你的立场是确保人们对自己充满同情，保持那种同情心，而且，你知道，

sentences.en: is this the right time for me to come on to training?
sentences.zh: 现在是我参加培训的正确时机吗？

sentences.en: And it's a really difficult question for us to grapple with.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们很难去应对的问题。

sentences.en: Before we hit record, something that we spoke about was, you know, how young I am.
sentences.zh: 在录音之前，我们谈到的一件事是，你知道，我有多年轻。

sentences.en: And, you know, we mentioned it now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们现在提到了。

sentences.en: I could have applied to training straight from university.
sentences.zh: 我本可以在大学毕业后直接申请培训。

sentences.en: I could have kind of accelerated the journey even more.
sentences.zh: 我本可以进一步加快这个旅程。

sentences.en: And I didn't.
sentences.zh: 但我没有。

sentences.en: And I had a supervisor at the time that was saying when I first applied for training, when I kind of thought, oh, I'm not sure if I'm ready, but I think I could be.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一位督导，当我第一次申请培训时，当我想到，哦，我不确定我是否准备好了，但我认为我可以。

sentences.en: So I'm going to give it a go.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算试一试。

sentences.en: My supervisor was really good at kind of keeping that open.
sentences.zh: 我的督导非常擅长保持开放的态度。

sentences.en: Is this something that you're ready for?
sentences.zh: 这是你准备好面对的事情吗？

sentences.en: Well, at the time, it felt really hard to think about.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时觉得很难去思考。

sentences.en: But now I'm really thankful I did.
sentences.zh: 但现在我很庆幸我做了。

sentences.en: And it's I'm still not sure that I'm ready for training.
sentences.zh: 而且我仍然不确定我是否为培训做好了准备。

sentences.en: And I'm still I don't know that there is this point that someone feels completely ready.
sentences.zh: 我仍然不知道是否有一个人会感到完全准备好的时刻。

sentences.en: But I feel that I'm coping, OK, and I feel that I've got this compassion that I hold toward myself despite and including, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我感觉我应付得来，我觉得我对自己怀有这种同情心，尽管包括，你知道，

sentences.en: all of these difficult experiences that I can still hold a stance of compassion toward myself, which feels ultimately the most important part.
sentences.zh: 所有这些困难的经历，我仍然可以对自己保持同情的态度，这感觉最终是最重要的部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you for sharing that.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢你的分享。

sentences.en: And, you know, when we're looking at readiness, you know, I'm always screening people that I mean, you know, to see, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我们审视准备程度时，你知道，我一直在筛选我所指的人，你知道，看看，

sentences.en: whether you'd tick the ready for clinical training box and, and, you know, I would for you, Jacob, you, you seem reflective, you seem grounded,
sentences.zh: 你是否会勾选“为临床培训做好准备”的方框，而且，你知道，我会为你勾选，Jacob，你看起来善于反思，看起来很稳重，

sentences.en: you seem able to draw on theory and to weave it inappropriately.
sentences.zh: 你看起来能够运用理论并将其适当地融入其中。

sentences.en: And, you know, you see, you seem contained, which is, you know, we don't want you to be too leaky, you know, there's got to be an element of humanness.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你看起来很克制，你知道，我们不希望你太“漏气”，你知道，必须要有一定的人性成分。

sentences.en: But we've also got to think that actually, we are confident in sending you out there to do clinical work with actual clients, and services and family groups.
sentences.zh: 但我们也必须考虑到，实际上，我们有信心派你去与真实的来访者、服务对象和家庭团体进行临床工作。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't, I wouldn't have any hesitation about ticking your ticking your yes box.
sentences.zh: 而且我不会，我不会有任何犹豫去勾选你的“是”方框。

sentences.en: But that's not saying that I'd expect you to be a perfect trainee.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说我期望你成为一个完美的实习生。

sentences.en: It's not saying that I'd expect myself to be a perfect supervisor.
sentences.zh: 这也不是说我期望自己成为一个完美的督导。

sentences.en: But what I would want for you and for anyone listening to this episode is to,
sentences.zh: 但我希望你，以及每一位收听本期节目的听众，能够做到的是，

sentences.en: to feel safe enough to be able to bring stuff to the relationship to discuss that supervision relationship,
sentences.zh: 感到足够安全，从而能够向督导关系中提出问题，去探讨这种督导关系，

sentences.en: to recognize that neither of you are perfect people, but you know, to optimize that relationship, really, and for you ultimately to feel safe enough to be able to do that,
sentences.zh: 认识到你们双方都不是完美的人，但你知道，要真正优化这种关系，最终让你感到足够安全去做到这一点，

sentences.en: to be honest and authentic and curious and, you know, draw in that theory, draw in reflective models.
sentences.zh: 做到诚实、真实、充满好奇，你知道，引入那些理论，引入那些反思模型。

sentences.en: And I guess ask for help when you need it, really, if and when you need it, so that you know that you're not having to be autonomous all of the time.
sentences.zh: 我想，在真正需要的时候寻求帮助，如果需要的话，这样你就知道你不必时刻保持独立。

sentences.en: It's, it's that striking that balance, isn't it between appropriate autonomy, and then not being, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是，这就是在适当的自主权之间取得平衡，不是吗？而不是，你知道，

sentences.en: so autonomous that you feel like you can operate the whole system without them, which I'm aware before we hit record, for a time period,
sentences.zh: 自主到让你觉得没有他们你也能运作整个系统，我意识到在录音之前，有一段时间，

sentences.en: you were having to do because of the way that the organization
sentences.zh: 因为组织结构的方式，你不得不这样做，

sentences.en: organization was structured, this is before training, it's really hard, you know, it's not being so dependent, that you're having to email your supervisor,
sentences.zh: 这是在培训之前，这真的很难，你知道，不是要变得那么依赖，以至于你不得不给你的督导发邮件，

sentences.en: or you want to be in their office every minute, or every single client you're with, you think, I wish my supervisor was seeing them.
sentences.zh: 或者你每一分钟都想待在他们的办公室里，或者你面对的每一个客户，你都会想，我真希望我的督导能看看他们。

sentences.en: It's, it is that fine balance.
sentences.zh: 这就是，这就是那种微妙的平衡。

sentences.en: And for me, that's been something I have had to learn to be more contained.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是我必须学习去变得更加克制的一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, like, I think originally, when I was an assistant, I used to want to email my supervisor, everything to check it, or to like, say, I've done this, you know, I've done this.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像，我想最初当我还是助理的时候，我总是想给我的督导发邮件，检查每一件事，或者说，我做了这个，你知道，我做了这个。

sentences.en: And over time, they're like, okay, but perhaps wait for supervision, because that's not urgent.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们会说，好的，但也许等到督导时间再说，因为那并不紧急。

sentences.en: And it's, it's just learning to, to hold that and be more contained.
sentences.zh: 而这，只是学习去，去把控这一点，变得更加克制。

sentences.en: It's, it's a whole process.
sentences.zh: 这，这是一个完整的过程。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And it is a process.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个过程。

sentences.en: And the process continues beyond training, through training, before training.
sentences.zh: 而且这个过程在培训之后、培训期间、培训之前都在持续。

sentences.en: And I think it's something that, you know, as you know, picking up the language that you were using, perfect, there's no, there is no perfect.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是，你知道，正如你所说，借用你刚才用的词，完美，没有，根本就没有完美。

sentences.en: Um, I know, I know, for me, I've always held this sense of perfectionism, I need to, and I think training and getting on to training does cultivate that to some extent,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道，我知道，对我来说，我一直有一种完美主义的心态，我需要，而且我认为培训以及进入培训在某种程度上确实培养了这一点，

sentences.en: you've got to kind of be slightly above and beyond other people to be able to get on.
sentences.zh: 你必须比其他人稍微优秀一点，才能获得机会。

sentences.en: And it does lend itself to that kind of experience and temperament.
sentences.zh: 这确实会导致那种经历和气质。

sentences.en: But I suppose, unlearning that and coming into these relationships,
sentences.zh: 但我认为，摒弃这一点并进入这些关系，

sentences.en: in supervision, where sometimes, it can feel really hard to kind of challenge the dynamic, the power dynamic, and kind of,
sentences.zh: 在督导中，有时会感觉真的很难去挑战这种动态，这种权力动态，以及，

sentences.en: you're also then potentially challenging some of the dynamics that you've held on to, and your internal working model,
sentences.zh: 你同时也可能在挑战你一直坚持的一些动态，以及你的内在工作模型，

sentences.en: or your kind of inner child is kind of experiencing this relationship in a certain way that feels difficult for you to challenge.
sentences.zh: 或者你的内在小孩正在以某种方式体验这种关系，让你觉得难以挑战。

sentences.en: But I suppose, but I suppose, holding yourself as an adult and holding yourself as a child, alongside everything you've experienced positively, feels really important.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，但我认为，将自己视为成年人，同时也将自己视为孩子，并结合你所经历的一切积极事物，这感觉非常重要。

sentences.en: And that challenge of, you know, challenging the dynamics and supervision is always probably going to be there.
sentences.zh: 而那种挑战，你知道，挑战督导中的动态，可能永远都会存在。

sentences.en: And I think in part because you're challenging, you know, the relationship, and you're kind of maybe creating a tiny rupture.
sentences.zh: 我认为部分原因是你在挑战，你知道，这种关系，而且你可能正在制造一个小小的裂痕。

sentences.en: And repair hasn't always been easy for lots of people.
sentences.zh: 而修复对许多人来说并不总是容易的。

sentences.en: So is it going to happen?
sentences.zh: 所以这会发生吗？

sentences.en: Are we going to repair?
sentences.zh: 我们能修复吗？

sentences.en: But also, in challenging that relationship, you might be challenging a wider system, a wider way of doing things.
sentences.zh: 但同时，在挑战那种关系时，你可能也在挑战一个更广泛的系统，一种更广泛的做事方式。

sentences.en: You might be challenging something.
sentences.zh: 你可能在挑战某些东西。

sentences.en: You might be challenging something that has always been there, and hasn't been questioned, because someone like you may not have been there to challenge you.
sentences.zh: 你可能在挑战一直存在且未被质疑的东西，因为可能没有像你这样的人去挑战它。

sentences.en: So I suppose, it's always a process, and there is no ideal.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这总是一个过程，没有理想状态。

sentences.en: And I think approaching these things with compassion feels really important for you to then be able to continue to kind of always adopt that curious stance of,
sentences.zh: 我认为带着同理心去处理这些事情，对你来说非常重要，这样你才能继续保持那种好奇的态度，去思考，

sentences.en: I wonder why these things are going on, and I wonder what they can tell us.
sentences.zh: 我想知道为什么会发生这些事情，我想知道它们能告诉我们什么。

sentences.en: So I suppose for me, that sense of being contained really comes from practice, really comes from experience of kind of having to do these things.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对我来说，那种克制感确实来自于实践，确实来自于不得不做这些事情的经验。

sentences.en: And, you know, as you mentioned, I did work in a system that we know isn't perfect.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如你提到的，我确实在一个我们都知道并不完美的系统中工作。

sentences.en: The NHS can be really difficult sometimes.
sentences.zh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）有时真的很难。

sentences.en: And I did work as a lone assistant psychologist for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实做了很长一段时间的孤身心理学助理。

sentences.en: And, you know, practicing what I preach,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，言行一致，

sentences.en: I can hold on to the positives that that's really given me this newfound sense of knowing what kind of psychologist I want to be and how I can operate within these systems that can challenge our intrinsic sense of how we want to care for people.
sentences.zh: 我可以坚持那些积极的方面，这确实给了我一种全新的认识，让我知道我想成为什么样的心理学家，以及我如何在这些系统中运作，这些系统可能会挑战我们内心深处想要照顾他人的方式。

sentences.en: But also, but also holding on to the negatives as well that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但同时，也要坚持那些消极的方面，你知道，

sentences.en: I didn't therefore have the kind of that really motherly and that kind of really caring experience that so many people would have had.
sentences.zh: 因此我没有那种非常母性、非常关怀的经历，而那是许多人可能拥有的。

sentences.en: And so there will naturally be differences in the style that you learn to adopt.
sentences.zh: 所以你学会采用的风格自然会有所不同。

sentences.en: And it's just that it's a style and you can question it and you can enlighten your supervisors, you can enlighten your peers and your colleagues in a way that feels compassionate.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种风格，你可以质疑它，你可以以一种富有同情心的方式启发你的督导、你的同伴和同事。

sentences.en: But it is certainly a process to learn how to do that.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个学习如何去做的过程。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I wish you a career and a life full of being able to repair the ruptures that serve you best, you know, so we can't repair all ruptures, nor do we want to sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我祝愿你拥有一个充满能够修复裂痕的职业生涯和生活，这最适合你，你知道，我们不能修复所有的裂痕，有时我们也不想修复。

sentences.en: But yeah, the ones that you want to keep.
sentences.zh: 但是的，那些你想保留的。

sentences.en: I hope that you're able to to appropriately repair them before we were planning this episode.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能够在我们计划这期节目之前适当地修复它们。

sentences.en: We thought there might be, you know, a chance to to record a couple of episodes today and to think about what other areas we might want to cover.
sentences.zh: 我们想过，你知道，今天有机会录制几期节目，并思考我们还想涵盖哪些其他领域。

sentences.en: And I've kept you talking for so long that we're not going to have a chance to do that today.
sentences.zh: 但我让你说了太久，以至于我们今天没机会做那个了。

sentences.en: But for anyone listening or watching this, if there's other future ideas for topics that they think would be really interesting for you and I to discuss in future,
sentences.zh: 但对于任何收听或观看的人，如果未来有其他话题，他们认为你和我讨论会非常有趣，

sentences.en: I'd love it if they drop that in the comments on YouTube or on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能在YouTube或Spotify的评论区留言，我会很高兴。

sentences.en: I've really, really, really, really valued our time talking today and thank you for for sharing your story so freely.
sentences.zh: 我真的、真的、真的、非常珍视我们今天交谈的时间，谢谢你如此坦诚地分享你的故事。

sentences.en: I know I speak for myself and for our audience who wish you all the very best with your training and whatever comes next.
sentences.zh: 我知道我代表我自己以及我们的听众，祝愿你在培训以及未来的一切中一切顺利。

sentences.en: Is there anything we haven't said, Jacob, that you kind of think we should be covering or leaving our leaving our audience with before we do finish?
sentences.zh: Jacob，还有什么我们没说到的，你觉得我们在结束之前应该涵盖或留给听众的吗？

sentences.en: It's a big question, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: And I feel thank you so much, by the way, that's really lovely to hear.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我感觉非常感谢，听到这些真的很棒。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've really enjoyed talking on this podcast as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我也真的很喜欢在这个播客上交谈。

sentences.en: It's I think, as I said, a really apt and a lovely place to be able to talk about these things.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正如我所说，这是一个非常贴切且可爱的地方，可以谈论这些事情。

sentences.en: So thank you for having me on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你邀请我参加这个播客。

sentences.en: But I think I would echo what you say, Marianne, if people do have something that they would find important to talk about or to explore in more depth.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我会呼应你所说的，Marianne，如果人们确实有觉得重要的话题想要谈论或深入探讨。

sentences.en: I would say that that to me is is more important because I can ramble on.
sentences.zh: 我会说这对我来说更重要，因为我可以滔滔不绝。

sentences.en: I can talk so much, which I'm happy to do, but I don't want to do it at the expense of other people's valuable time.
sentences.zh: 我可以谈论很多，我很乐意这样做，但我不想以牺牲他人宝贵的时间为代价。

sentences.en: So if there is something that people find useful, please let Marianne know and we can definitely have a more extended conversation about these things.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有什么人们觉得有用的东西，请告诉Marianne，我们绝对可以就这些事情进行更深入的对话。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Thank you again for your time, Jacob.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你的时间，Jacob。

sentences.en: And yeah, I hope that you can have we're recording this in December, but I hope you can have a really nice kind of decompression over the Christmas period.
sentences.zh: 是的，我希望你能有——我们是在十二月录制的——但我希望你在圣诞期间能有一个很好的放松。

sentences.en: And I hope that you are spoiled and nurtured and looked after wonderfully.
sentences.zh: 我希望你被宠爱、被滋养，并得到极好的照顾。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to Jacob for his time and also in sticking with me for the upload, because I know that took some time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢Jacob抽出时间，也感谢他坚持陪我完成上传，因为我知道那花了一些时间。

sentences.en: So thank you, Jacob.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你，Jacob。

sentences.en: What a fascinating, thoughtful, inspiring gueSt.
sentences.zh: 多么迷人、体贴、鼓舞人心的嘉宾。

sentences.en: I would love it if you are able to show Jacob your support both on YouTube and if you are listening on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在YouTube和Spotify上给Jacob支持，我会很高兴。

sentences.en: It feels like a real privilege to have had Jacob's time and I hope you feel the same way.
sentences.zh: 能有Jacob的时间感觉真是一种荣幸，我希望你也有同样的感受。

sentences.en: Just after we finished, Jacob was telling me how much part of his weekly fabric this podcast has been.
sentences.zh: 就在我们结束录制后，Jacob告诉我这个播客已经成为他每周生活的一部分。

sentences.en: And I really love that idea.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这个想法。

sentences.en: I won't share his background, how he listens, but I would love if you felt comfortable to share yours.
sentences.zh: 我不会分享他的背景，他是如何收听的，但我很乐意如果你愿意分享你的。

sentences.en: Why not drop that in the comments, too?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在评论区也写下来呢？

sentences.en: You know, I'm not a beginner podcast now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在不是播客新手了。

sentences.en: The podcast by the time you listen to this episode will be four years old.
sentences.zh: 当你听到这一集时，这个播客已经四岁了。

sentences.en: We've already had our 200th episode series, you know, I'm not planning on giving up anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 我们已经完成了200集系列节目，你知道，我不打算很快放弃。

sentences.en: But this means that people will have started their A levels and finish them.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着人们可能已经开始并完成了他们的A-Level课程。

sentences.en: People will have started their degrees and finish them.
sentences.zh: 人们可能已经开始并完成了他们的学位。

sentences.en: People will have applied for training courses and finish them all during the life cycle of this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 人们可能已经申请并完成了他们的培训课程，这一切都在这个播客的生命周期内。

sentences.en: So that is really wonderful.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很棒。

sentences.en: If you are a super fan of the show or if you would like to support me to be able to carry on being a creator in this space for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果你是这个节目的超级粉丝，或者如果你想支持我，让我能尽可能长时间地在这个领域继续创作。

sentences.en: Why not consider becoming a paid subscriber,
sentences.zh: 为什么不考虑成为付费订阅者呢，

sentences.en: which you can do for just a couple of pounds a month where you get exclusive behind the scenes content and footage and you get kind of insider reflections from me.
sentences.zh: 你每月只需几英镑，就可以获得独家的幕后内容和花絮，还能得到我的一些内部反思。

sentences.en: You can do that by joining my YouTube channel as a member or by joining on Apple where you can get a three day free trial or directly through Captivate, who hosts my podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过加入我的YouTube频道会员，或者在Apple上加入（那里有三天免费试用），或者直接通过托管我播客的Captivate来做到这一点。

sentences.en: You can get a free trial there as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在那里获得免费试用。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的到来。

sentences.en: I love doing this.
sentences.zh: 我热爱做这件事。

sentences.en: I love creating this content.
sentences.zh: 我热爱创作这些内容。

sentences.en: You might be here because you're an aspiring psychologist or you might be here just because you're interested in people and human stories.
sentences.zh: 你可能在这里是因为你是一位有抱负的心理学家，或者你在这里只是因为你对人和人类故事感兴趣。

sentences.en: Maybe for this episode, you're here because you yourself have had some experience in the care system.
sentences.zh: 也许对于这一集，你在这里是因为你自己有一些在护理系统中的经历。

sentences.en: You are care experienced or maybe you are supporting someone who is care experienced or want to understand them and their position and situation better.
sentences.zh: 你有护理经历，或者也许你正在支持某位有护理经历的人，或者想更好地理解他们及其处境。

sentences.en: Whoever you are, wherever you're watching or listening, you are so welcome.
sentences.zh: 无论你是谁，无论你在哪里观看或收听，你都非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the aspiring psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将走上Marianne博士的“有抱负的心理学家播客”之路。

sentences.en: Did I ever tell you about the time I earned 300 pounds whilst I was at a Pilates class?
sentences.zh: 我有没有告诉过你，我曾在上普拉提课时赚了300英镑的事？

sentences.en: And no, spoiler alert, I wasn't teaching the Pilates.
sentences.zh: 不，剧透一下，我不是在教普拉提。

sentences.en: It was money coming into my business whilst I was doing something completely different.
sentences.zh: 那是我在做完全不同的事情时，我的业务进账的钱。

sentences.en: If you've ever wondered how you might create income that isn't directly tied to your time, there's a free challenge starting on the 2nd of November.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经想过如何创造不直接与你的时间挂钩的收入，11月2日有一个免费的挑战赛。

sentences.en: It's called The Race to Recurring Revenue.
sentences.zh: 它叫“循环收入竞赛”。

sentences.en: It's hosted by Sophie Foot and I'd love you to join through my link so I can support you too.
sentences.zh: 它由Sophie Foot主持，我很乐意你通过我的链接加入，这样我也能支持你。

sentences.en: The details are in the show notes or you can drop me a DM via socials.
sentences.zh: 详情在节目说明中，或者你可以通过社交媒体给我发私信。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，继续节目。
